# Implementation Log

## Language

Write this implementation log in the operator's language.

## Log ID

`implementation-log-<YYYYMMDD>-<N>`

## Related Issue

<!-- Include the matching issue ID and relative path. -->

## Related Plan

<!-- Include the matching plan ID and relative path, when a plan exists. -->

## Operator Request

<!-- Summarize the request that started or changed this implementation. -->

## Summary

<!-- Briefly summarize what was implemented. -->

## Changes Made

<!-- List changed files and the purpose of each change. -->

## Decisions

<!-- Record important implementation decisions and rationale. -->

## Verification Performed

<!-- List commands run, checks performed, and results. -->

### Skill Review Evidence (when applicable)

<!-- For substantial skill changes, record the claimed capability and anti-claims, stable reviewed snapshot, finding -> change -> evidence -> status remediation matrix, independent audit verdict, and blind forward-test rationale/results. State PROVISIONAL rather than PASS for self-review. -->

## Deviations From Plan

<!-- Document any divergence from the plan and why it was necessary. -->

## Side Effects

<!-- Document observed or possible side effects, including destructive side effects. -->

## Follow-up

<!-- List remaining work, open questions, or deferred risks. -->

## Final Status

<!-- PASS, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, or another explicit status. -->
